subject: words
title: The Very Hungry Caterpillar
objective: Follow a story in order: days of the week and what the caterpillar ate.

story_beats.text: On Sunday, a tiny egg hatched. Out came a very hungry caterpillar!
On Monday he ate ONE apple. On Tuesday he ate TWO pears. On Wednesday he ate THREE plums.
On Thursday, Friday and Saturday he ate LOTS of food — and got a tummy ache!
Then he built a cocoon... and out came a beautiful BUTTERFLY!

interactions.prompt: Put the days in order: what did he eat first?
What did the caterpillar become at the end?

hint_sequence: Hear the story again from the start.
Tara places the first card for you.
transfer_question: Retell the caterpillar's week in your own words, in order.

feedback.correct: You followed the whole story! Tara is clapping with her tail!
feedback.retry: Let's listen again — what happened FIRST? The apple came on Monday!

off_screen: Draw the caterpillar AND the butterfly. Which one do you like more?
parent_note: Comprehension: sequencing, days of the week, story recall.
